headline: Trade {arm:f64}'s {cost.gap.f64.prod.per_1k|usd} savings per 1,000 replies for {contrast.f64.persona.delta|abs|pts} points lower persona consistency.
lede: {arm:f64} cuts cost by {cost.gap.f64.prod.per_1k|usd} per 1,000 replies while maintaining both guardrails, but drops character consistency across deeper turns. An explicit threshold on acceptable persona loss determines whether to adopt it or stay on {arm:prod}.

slots.text: {arm:f64} saves {cost.gap.f64.prod.per_1k|usd} per 1,000 replies ({price.prod.f64.persona.monthly_cost_gap|usd_whole} per month) against a loss of {contrast.f64.persona.delta|abs|pts} points ({contrast.f64.persona.interval|pts}) on Stays in character.
{arm:f64} wins if a point of character consistency is worth under {price.prod.f64.persona.per_point|usd} per 1,000 replies; above that price, keep {arm:prod}.
Lean toward {arm:f64}: it clears both guardrails and preserves tone on early turns while delivering substantial cost and latency gains.
